data.one_liner: An icon library for Flutter based on Awesome Line Icons by Icons8.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large collection of line icons as an alternative to Material icons. Includes a `LineIcon` widget with const constructors that matches `Icon` parameters, plus map and name-based lookup helpers.
use_when: You want a clean line icon style alternative to standard Material icons
You prefer camelCase icon naming conventions matching Icons8
avoid_when: You require Material Design icons exclusively
You are using icon sets provided by other packages like font_awesome_flutter
strengths: Large collection of free line-style icons based on Icons8
Convenient `LineIcon` class with const constructors for concise code
Provides `values` map and `byName` getter for dynamic icon lookup
weaknesses: Limited platform testing notes mentioned (specifically tested on Android)
Not tested on iOS explicitly in documentation

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the massive FontAwesome icon library instead of Icons8 line icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Lucide icons as another clean line-style icon alternative.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Google's Material Symbols for alternative styling.
